about.what_body: Kihci-masinahikan accessibility audit ohci. WCAG kâ-wanihtâk âpacihtâwina ohci nâtamihk, pîkiskwêwin wîhcaw, pimipayiwin mîna copy audit report.
about.what_wcag: Coverage extends up to WCAG 2.2 (Level A and AA) across both web and native app contexts.
about.step_1_body: Masinahika kâ-wâpahcikawin — tipiyaw-isihcikêwin, kîsikâwihikêwin, mîna tânisi âpacihtâyin.
about.step_2_body: Use the Priority Up/Priority Down arrows on each result to tune how results are ranked. Star to show first. Archive to hide it.
about.step_3_body: Tânêhki ohci (mêkwâc "Kahkiyaw:") mîna AI kani kîsikâwihikêwin.
about.step_4_body: Add a location prefix (e.g. "Global:") or use AI to help revise the wording.
about.feature_ai_body: Kâ-wanihtâk âpacihtâwin kîsikaw nota. API key, IA provider — namôya server.
about.feature_languages_body: 50 ota nêhiyawêwina RTL ohci. Kihci-masinahikanihk kîsikaw.
about.feature_a11y_body: WCAG 2.2 mîna kâ-wanihtâk: focus, live region, keyboard, reduced motion, high-contrast.
about.coming_auth: Google mîna GitHub isi sign in gdam kîsikaw setting devices ohci.
about.coming_ai: IA providers: OpenAI, Google Gemini, mîna latlh.
settings.confirm_reset_all_body: API keys mîna kihci-masinahikan kahkiyaw wanihtâk. Namôya kîsikaw.
settings.unsaved_body: You have unsaved changes to your AI settings. What would you like to do?

settings.voting_on: Vote controls are visible on each result.
about.step_5_body: Use the up/down arrows on each result to tune how results are ranked. Star a result to always pin it first. Archive entries you never want to see again.
